body.statement: For every compatible strictly positive input, \(qU-qL=cU-cL+w11\ge w11>0\); thus the two experiments never point-identify \(q\) in the stated positive-table model.
body.justification: The width identity distinguishes compatibility from identification and gives a required sanity reduction.
body.gap: The generic methods return numerical intervals but do not state the strictly positive nonidentification margin for this family.
body.consumer: An experimental designer learns that these two regimes alone cannot point-identify the joint-intervention risk.
